project.name: rumo
project.objective: Rumo is a life-admin navigation product that turns a user situation into relevant facts, dependencies, correct next actions, parallel actions, waits or blockers, progress, and a completed objective while preserving authoritative provenance and freshness.
targetUsers: People moving home or setting up a new home in Portugal
People moving home or setting up a new home in Portugal, beginning with deeper municipal support for Évora

constraints: Do not become an open-ended chatbot, generic public-service directory, or generic checklist application.
Do not add life-event families during M03.1.
No database, authentication, AI/LLM routing, or raw free-text analytics by default.
Canonical content is in the repository; user progress is browser-local versioned persistence.
nonGoals: No CMS, document upload, automated submissions, or generic generative-answer path.
businessRules: Routing prioritizes executable tasks, then parallel executable tasks, then waits; blocked steps are never actionable.
Steps have task, wait, or subjourney semantics.
Content versioning must be deterministic and persisted state must be revalidated after content changes.
architectureNotes: The domain is pure and framework-independent; canonical content is declarative with no executable callbacks.
Persistence distinguishes schemaVersion, contentVersion, updatedAt, and sessions.
Personal administrative facts must not appear in URLs.

requirements.title: Production Foundation
requirements.description: Convert the validated prototype architecture into a production-grade, deterministic, testable application foundation without expanding MVP scope.
acceptanceCriteria: The M03.1 work graph covers domain, routing, content, persistence, search, shell integration, and release validation.
The MVP remains limited to moving home and setting up a new home in Portugal.

decisions.decision: AIQT is the canonical operational work state.
decisions.reason: Work-unit scope, dependencies, evidence, and handoff must be durable and provider-neutral.
decisions.impact: Development Agents execute only active bounded work units.

decisions.decision: Use browser-local versioned persistence for runtime progress.
decisions.reason: No database or authentication requirement exists.
decisions.impact: Content-version mismatch requires revalidation or rebuild on resume.
